kitEvidence.formula:
Ornn charges, dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.4) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.4) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] physical damage. If Ornn rams into terrain, he creates a shockwave that Knocks Up enemies for [1.25] seconds and applies the same damage to those not hit by the charge.

Ornn's charge destroys magma pillars and terrain created by enemies.

builds.name: Bellows Breath: health damage without AP scaling
builds.summary: Investigate a high Bellows Breath plus one Brittle detonation result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate a high Bellows Breath plus one Brittle detonation result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 W deals 16% enemy max HP over 0.75s; level-18 Brittle adds the source's level-scaled max-HP magic packet when legally detonated. Neither has a direct AP coefficient. Magic penetration, nearby Abyssal Mask and verified conditional amplifiers can improve these packets even when the purchased AP/AD does not. The physical attack used to trigger Brittle is a separate delivery packet.

kitEvidence.formula:
Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing [12 / 13 / 14 / 15 / 16]% max Health magic damage over [0.75] seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for [3] seconds.

Immobilizing effects on Brittle targets have their duration increased by 30% and deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(0.09 → 0.17; raw flags preserved)] max Health magic damage. Ornn's Attacks against Brittle targets Knock them Back, dealing the additional damage.
